import re

base = "02 - Spielleiterbereich/WIP/Gegenstände/Waffen/Waffen/"

groesse_to_plaetze = {1: 1, 2: 1, 3: 2, 4: 3, 5: 4}

stapelgroesse_overrides = {
    "Wurfmesser.md": 4,
}

import glob
files = glob.glob\(base + "*.md"\)

for f in files:
    s = open\(f, encoding="utf-8"\).read\(\)
    orig = s

    m = re.search\(r"^Größe:\\s*\(\\d+\)", s, re.M\)
    if not m:
        print\("NO GRÖSSE:", f\)
        continue
    groesse = int\(m.group\(1\)\)
    plaetze = groesse_to_plaetze[groesse]
    fname = f.split\("/"\)[-1]
    stapel = stapelgroesse_overrides.get\(fname, 1\)

    # replace "Gewicht: X Pfund" or "Gewicht:" \(blank\) line with Plaetze/Stapelgroesse
    new_lines = f"Plaetze: {plaetze}\\nStapelgroesse: {stapel}"
    s2 = re.sub\(r"^Gewicht:.*$", new_lines, s, count=1, flags=re.M\)
    if s2 == s:
        print\("NO GEWICHT LINE MATCHED:", f\)
    s = s2

    # remove any leftover Kategorie: line \(blank or filled\)
    s = re.sub\(r"^Kategorie:.*\\n", "", s, flags=re.M\)

    if s != orig:
        open\(f, "w", encoding="utf-8"\).write\(s\)

print\("done"\)
PYEOF)
